intro: Convert mechanical horsepower (hp) to kilowatts (kW) accurately for automotive engine specs, electric motors, HVAC compressors, and generators. Calculating horsepower in kilowatts uses the exact imperial definition 1 hp = 745.69987 W, so 1 hp in kW equals 0.7457 kW. Use the calculator above or scan common engine and motor ratings from 1 hp to 1,000 hp in the reference chart below.
alsoWrittenAs: horsepower to kW, mechanical hp to kW, bhp to kW, brake horsepower to kilowatts

mistakesAndEdgeCases.title: Mechanical Horsepower (hp / bhp) vs. Metric PS (CV) vs. Boiler Horsepower
items: Mechanical and automotive brake horsepower (hp / bhp) equal 0.7457 kW, whereas European metric horsepower (PS or CV, Pferdestärke / chevaux-vapeur) is slightly smaller at 0.7355 kW (1 hp ≈ 1.01387 PS/CV).
Do not confuse brake horsepower (bhp) with steam boiler horsepower (bhp_boiler): 1 boiler horsepower equals 9.8095 kW (33,475 BTU/h)—more than 13 times larger than 1 mechanical hp.

faqs.question: How many kilowatts (kW) are in 1 horsepower (hp)?
faqs.answer: There are 0.7457 kilowatts (0.74569987 kW) in 1 mechanical horsepower (hp). Conversely, 1 kilowatt equals 1.34102 mechanical horsepower.

faqs.question: How do you convert hp to kW?
faqs.answer: Multiply the mechanical horsepower figure by 0.74569987 (or divide by 1.341022): kW = hp × 0.74569987. For example, 100 hp × 0.74569987 = 74.56999 kW.

faqs.question: Is brake horsepower (bhp) to kW the same as mechanical hp to kW?
faqs.answer: Yes—in engine and motor datasheets, brake horsepower (bhp) uses the same 745.7-watt mechanical horsepower definition (1 bhp = 0.7457 kW). However, European metric CV/PS equals 0.7355 kW, and steam boiler horsepower equals 9.8095 kW.

faqs.question: What is 200 hp in kW?
faqs.answer: 200 mechanical horsepower equals 149.13997 kilowatts (rounds to 149.14 kW).
